historicalExamples.name: Primary Button
historicalExamples.description: The main call to action, outlined rather than filled so the accent stays legible as ink in both themes.
historicalExamples.html: <button class="ds-btn ds-btn-primary">Homepage <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7 17 10-10"></path><path d="M9 7h8v8"></path></svg></button>
historicalExamples.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 20px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 23px; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--accent); font-family: inherit; font-size: .84rem; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary svg { width: 1em; height: 1em; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.7; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { border-color: var(--accent-hover); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 10%, transparent); color: var(--accent-hover); transform: translateY(-1px); outline: 0; }

historicalExamples.name: Secondary Button
historicalExamples.description: The supporting CTA that stays quieter than the primary action.
historicalExamples.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 23px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--text); font: inherit; font-size: .84rem; font-weight: 700; transition: border-color 180ms ease, background-color 180ms ease, color 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover, .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { border-color: var(--text); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 50%, transparent); outline: 0; transform: translateY(-1px); }

historicalExamples.name: Tag Chip
historicalExamples.description: A compact metadata chip used for tags and quick filters.
historicalExamples.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--surface-strong); color: var(--muted); font-family: inherit; font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.15; text-decoration: none; text-transform: lowercase; transition: color 180ms ease, background-color 180ms ease; } .ds-chip:hover, .ds-chip:focus-visible { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface-strong) 82%, var(--accent)); color: var(--accent); outline: 0; }

historicalExamples.name: App Card
historicalExamples.description: The recurring content card for app listings and related recommendations.
historicalExamples.html:
Chimlo

Tracks Codex and Claude Code sessions from the MacBook notch.

Best for: Developers supervising several coding agents.

aideveloper
historicalExamples.css: .ds-card { display: grid; gap: 16px; min-height: 286px; padding: 24px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--surface) 96%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 18px 55px rgba(27, 35, 42, 0.08); transition: box-shadow 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease, background-color 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; font-family: var(--display); font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: .95rem; line-height: 1.55; } .ds-card-kicker strong { color: var(--text); } .ds-chip-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; align-content: flex-start; } .ds-card:hover, .ds-card:focus-within { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 42%, var(--line)); background: var(--surface); box-shadow: 0 26px 68px rgba(27, 35, 42, 0.14); transform: translateY(-2px); outline: 0; }

historicalExamples.name: Site Header
historicalExamples.description: The sticky shell that carries the brand, search, archive, and theme controls.
historicalExamples.html: App Waypoint
historicalExamples.css: .ds-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 28px; min-height: 84px; padding: 0 clamp(24px, 3.2vw, 38px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); background: radial-gradient(circle at 17% 32%, rgba(255,255,255,.05), transparent 34%), var(--header-fog); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(115%); } .ds-brand, .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; } .ds-brand { gap: 21px; color: var(--text); font-family: var(--display); font-size: clamp(1.65rem, 2.45vw, 2rem); letter-spacing: .12em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-brand-mark { width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50%; background: #f7f0e4; } .ds-nav { gap: clamp(22px, 3.4vw, 42px); } .ds-icon-btn, .ds-icon-link { display: grid; width: 38px; height: 38px; padding: 0; place-items: center; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text); text-decoration: none; transition: color 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-icon-btn svg, .ds-icon-link svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.7; } .ds-icon-btn:hover, .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible, .ds-icon-link:hover, .ds-icon-link:focus-visible { color: var(--accent); outline: 0; } .ds-icon-btn:hover, .ds-icon-btn:focus-visible { transform: rotate(12deg); } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-icon-btn, .ds-icon-link { width: 44px; height: 44px; } } @media (max-width: 680px) { .ds-header { min-height: 70px; gap: 10px; padding: 0 16px; } .ds-brand { gap: 9px; font-size: 1.35rem; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-brand-mark { width: 40px; height: 40px; } .ds-nav { gap: 12px; } .ds-icon-btn, .ds-icon-link { width: 44px; height: 44px; } .ds-icon-btn svg, .ds-icon-link svg { width: 19px; height: 19px; } }

historicalExamples.name: Directory Controls
historicalExamples.description: A flex row: the live count leads at its natural width and carries the auto right margin that pushes visible Search apps, Filter and Sort to the end. The count is not a surface; search is 280px and the two menus are 180px each. Collections and Tags live inside Filter.
historicalExamples.html:
Showing 24 of 102 apps
CollectionsTags
historicalExamples.css: .ds-directory-bar { position: relative; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; align-items: stretch; } .ds-directory-count { display: flex; min-height: 52px; align-items: center; margin: 0 auto 0 0; padding: 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .04em; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-directory-search { display: grid; flex: 0 1 280px; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr); min-height: 52px; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 13px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface); } .ds-directory-search svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: var(--muted); stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 2; } .ds-directory-search input { min-width: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text); font: inherit; font-size: 1rem; outline: 0; } .ds-directory-filter, .ds-directory-sort { flex: 0 0 180px; min-height: 52px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface); } .ds-directory-filter { position: relative; padding: 0; } .ds-directory-filter > button, .ds-directory-sort { display: flex; width: 100%; min-height: 52px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text); font: inherit; font-size: .84rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-filter-panel { position: absolute; top: calc(100% + 12px); left: -1px; width: calc(200% + 20px); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 10px; background: var(--surface); } @media (max-width: 920px) { .ds-directory-bar { gap: 12px; } .ds-directory-count, .ds-directory-search { width: 100%; margin: 0; } .ds-directory-search { flex: 1 1 100%; } .ds-directory-filter, .ds-directory-sort { flex: 1 1 0; } .ds-filter-panel { width: calc(200% + 16px); } }

} .ds-search-icon { width: 24px; height: 24px; color: var(--muted); fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.7; } .ds-search-input { width: 100%; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--text); font: inherit; font-size: clamp(1.1rem, 2vw, 1.45rem); font-weight: 600; outline: 0; } .ds-search-input::placeholder { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--muted) 78%, transparent); } .ds-search-close { display: grid; width: 36px; height: 36px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 50%; background: transparent; color: var(--muted); transition: color 180ms ease, background-color 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease; } .ds-search-close svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.7; } .ds-search-close:hover, .ds-search-close:focus-visible { border-color: var(--line);
